I initially registered with the practice due to its convenient location; however, the behaviour I encountered was unprofessional, dismissive, and distressing.
On the day in question, I contacted the practice earlier in the morning to book an appointment and was informed that availability existed at 3:00 pm, but that I would need to attend the practice in person. I left work early and arrived at 2:50 pm to explain my symptoms and the advice I had received earlier. Before I was able to speak, the receptionist abruptly told me to leave and return at 3:00 pm. I complied politely and thanked her before leaving.
When I returned at 3:00 pm and queued at reception, a couple with a baby entered behind me. The receptionist repeatedly shouted over me to them, stating loudly, “Hey! Hello! Hello! You need to listen when I’m calling you, thanks,” in a manner that was rude and unnecessary. I waited patiently while she attended to them.
When it was finally my turn, I explained my symptoms and was told dismissively that my appointment was actually at 3:30 pm and that I could either wait elsewhere or leave and come back. I chose to step out briefly and returned at approximately 3:22 pm, at which point I went to sit in the waiting area. In front of other patients, the receptionist scoffed audibly with a colleague, called my name, and spoke to me aggressively, stating: “You can’t just walk in here whenever you want, you need to check in with me, you understand.” I was extremely embarrassed by this public reprimand and apologised despite having received no prior instruction to do so.
I would like to note that the doctor I saw was kind, professional, and informative. I was advised that a follow-up appointment would be arranged and that I would receive a message confirming this; however, no message was ever received.
As I was leaving, I politely said “thank you, goodbye” to the receptionist and was met with a visibly disgusted look in response.
Two days later, following advice from A&E, I contacted the practice to book an appointment for a GP referral for a scan. The receptionist I spoke to stated bluntly, “I’m not booking an appointment for a scan, we don’t do that here.” When I explained that I required a referral as instructed by A&E, she responded abruptly, “Right… no we can’t,” and ended the call.
Due to these repeated experiences of rudeness, lack of professionalism, and refusal to provide appropriate assistance, I have since registered with a different GP practice. I find it deeply concerning that patients seeking medical care are treated in this manner, particularly when they may already be unwell or distressed.
I hope this complaint is taken seriously and that appropriate steps are taken to address the conduct of reception staff, as it reflects poorly on the practice and directly impacts patient care.",null,[0,232]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21kc2RtTXROR1ZoV0ZOR1lXeG5PRmxMWm5WVVRVRRAB!2m1!1s0x0:0x5c845a0a86f6ca54!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOmdsdmMtNGVhWFNGYWxnOFlLZnVUTUE%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21kc2RtTXROR1ZoV0ZOR1lXeG5PRmxMWm5WVVRVRRAB&t=1&&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwj77fCbxbeTAxVPLGMBHZWuHyMQoykICigB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwj77fCbxbeTAxVPLGMBHZWuHyMQ0pMFCAgoAg"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFBeHBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSMUZoZFV4YVlsOWZSV2hETmtSNldEUnJaV3RxVG5kRmJWUkdiMEZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpSUlVOYVFuRTBkR3h6V1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xKWGMyODBTV0YyVERKV1pYaDNhbk5TWDFRMVpIYxAB",["0x0:0x5c845a0a86f6ca54",null,1767114760586901,1767114760586901,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/116846936905050454737/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Sheriff Khan","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocLJ1N7d29zcj_gQ8s7YbfsyhWhTV_D3p6cZpCdJPZrOJgJXoA=s120-c-rp-mo-ba2-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/116846936905050454737?hl=en"],"116846936905050454737",null,9,3,null,[1,4,1],1,["Local Guide · 9 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwj77fCbxbeTAxVPLGMBHZWuHyMQ7LoGCAwoAA"]]]],null,"2 months ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[1],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["Very rude stuff!!!! reading the reviews it truly saddens me too hear such negative responses, from my own personal experience and being with this surgery for nearly 10 years I can honestly say I see the same doctor and speak to the same people on a regular basis and I’ve received nothing but care ,kindness and compassion, it’s the old saying isn’t it treat people how you want to be treated yourself.

On many occasions I have witnessed myself first hand patients coming in and verbally being rude to reception staff due to them not having any appointments left, it’s not there fault, nor do they get paid enough to be taking that kind of verbal attitude.

My doctor comes in early and is the majority of the time the last one out, he works many many hours to help save the lives of people in Highbury, he goes without lunch and works through to make calls and goes above and beyond, we as patients don’t see always what goes on behind closed doors and just how much doctors and nurses have to do please have some kind of understanding and compassion.

Dr Holthaulsen I’m so truly greatful for all the help kindness and support that you have given me, battles I’ve faced I’ve not faced them alone.

Sandra is another person who is more than special she is kind, caring and has a wonderful heart, most of all this young lady will stop her day for a listening ear to someone else, both you and dr holthousen truly are something very very special.
